tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Check the health and status of the SharpLens MCP server and workspace. Returns server status, solution loaded state, project/document counts, cache size, and configuration. O(1) by default; set includeDiagnostics=true to also compile a sample of projects and report error/warning counts (slower). Call this first to verify the server is ready.

includeDiagnostics.description: Also compile up to five projects and report error/warning counts (default: false). Off by default because the compilation can take tens of seconds on a large solution.

tools.name: load_solution
tools.description: Load a .NET solution for analysis. MUST be called before using any other analysis tools. Returns: projectCount, documentCount, and load time. Use health_check to verify current state.

tools.name: sync_documents
tools.description:
Synchronize document changes from disk into the loaded solution. Call this after using Edit/Write tools to ensure Roslyn has fresh content.

USAGE:
- sync_documents(filePaths: ["src/Foo.cs", "src/Bar.cs"]) - sync specific files
- sync_documents() - sync ALL documents (refresh entire solution)

WHEN TO CALL:
- After using Edit tool to modify .cs files
- After using Write tool to create new .cs files
- After deleting .cs files
- NOT needed after using SharpLensMcp refactoring tools (they auto-update)

HANDLES: Modified files (updates content), new files (adds to solution), deleted files (removes from solution).
Much faster than load_solution - only updates documents, doesn't re-parse projects.

filePaths.description: Optional: specific file paths to sync. If omitted, syncs ALL documents from disk.

tools.name: get_symbol_info
tools.description: Get detailed semantic information about a symbol at a specific position. IMPORTANT: Uses ZERO-BASED coordinates. If your editor shows 'Line 14, Column 5', pass line=13, column=4. Returns symbol kind, type, namespace, documentation, and location.

line.description: Zero-based line number (Visual Studio line 14 = line 13 here)

column.description: Zero-based column number (Visual Studio col 5 = col 4 here)

tools.name: go_to_definition
tools.description: Fast navigation to symbol definition. Returns the definition location without finding all references. IMPORTANT: Uses ZERO-BASED coordinates (editor line 10 = pass line 9).

filePath.description: Absolute path to source file containing the symbol

line.description: Zero-based line number (editor line - 1)

tools.name: find_references
tools.description: Find all references to a symbol across the entire solution. Returns file paths, line numbers, code context, and a `kind` for each reference: write (assignment LHS, ++/--, ref/out arg), invocation (call target), cast (cast target type), typeof, nameof, attribute, or read. IMPORTANT: Uses ZERO-BASED coordinates (editor line 10 = pass line 9).

filePath.description: Absolute path to source file containing the symbol

line.description: Zero-based line number (editor line - 1)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of references to return (default: 100). Results are truncated with a hint if limit is exceeded.

kind.description: Optional kind filter (case-insensitive). One of: write, invocation, cast, typeof, nameof, attribute, read. When set, the response includes totalReferences (unfiltered) and totalReferencesAfterFilter so callers see both numbers.

tools.name: find_implementations
tools.description: Find all implementations of an interface or abstract class. Returns implementing types with their locations. IMPORTANT: Uses ZERO-BASED coordinates (editor line - 1).

line.description: Zero-based line number

maxResults.description: Maximum number of implementations to return (default: 50). Results are truncated with a hint if limit is exceeded.

tools.name: get_type_hierarchy
tools.description: Get the inheritance hierarchy (base types and derived types) for a type. Returns baseTypes chain and derivedTypes list. IMPORTANT: Uses ZERO-BASED coordinates (editor line - 1).

line.description: Zero-based line number

maxDerivedTypes.description: Maximum number of derived types to return (default: 50). Results are truncated with a hint if limit is exceeded.

tools.name: search_symbols
tools.description: Search for types, methods, properties, etc. by name across the solution. Default glob mode supports wildcards (e.g., '*Handler' finds classes ending with 'Handler'); matchMode='fuzzy' uses the IDE pattern matcher with camel-hump matching ('RSvc' finds RoslynService). CASING: glob/substring matching is case-INSENSITIVE; fuzzy matching treats uppercase query letters as camel-hump anchors (effectively case-sensitive on them). PAGINATION: Returns totalCount and hasMore. Use offset to paginate through results.

query.description: Search query. Glob mode: wildcards * (any characters) and ? (single character), e.g. 'Handler', '*Handler', 'Get*', 'I?Service'. Fuzzy mode: camel humps and partial names, e.g. 'RSvc'. Case-insensitive.

matchMode.description: 'glob' (default) or 'fuzzy' (IDE-grade camel-hump/partial matching via Roslyn's pattern matcher)

kind.description: Optional: filter by symbol kind. For types use: Class, Interface, Struct, Enum, Delegate. For members use: Method, Property, Field, Event. Other: Namespace. Case-insensitive.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results per page (default: 50)

namespaceFilter.description: Optional: filter by namespace (supports wildcards). Examples: 'MyApp.Core.*', '*.Services', 'MyApp.*.Handlers'. Case-insensitive.

offset.description: Offset for pagination (default: 0). Use pagination.nextOffset from previous response to get next page.

tools.name: semantic_query
tools.description:
Advanced semantic code query with multiple filters. Find symbols based on their semantic properties.

EXAMPLES:
- Async methods without CancellationToken: isAsync=true, parameterExcludes=["CancellationToken"]
- Public static methods: accessibility="Public", isStatic=true
- Classes with [Obsolete]: kinds=["Class"], attributes=["ObsoleteAttribute"]

FILTERS: All specified filters are combined with AND logic. Omit a filter to skip it. Returns symbol details with locations.

kinds.description: Optional: filter by symbol kinds (can specify multiple). For types: Class, Interface, Struct, Enum, Delegate. For members: Method, Property, Field, Event. Example: ['Class', 'Interface']

isAsync.description: Optional: filter methods by async/await (true for async methods, false for sync methods)

namespaceFilter.description: Optional: filter by namespace (supports wildcards). Examples: 'MyApp.Core.*', '*.Services'

accessibility.description: Optional: filter by accessibility (matches the reported DeclaredAccessibility name). Values: Public, Private, Internal, Protected, ProtectedOrInternal, ProtectedAndInternal

isStatic.description: Optional: filter by static modifier (true for static, false for instance)

type.description: Optional: filter fields/properties by their type. Partial match. Example: 'ILogger' finds all ILogger fields/properties

returnType.description: Optional: filter methods by return type. Partial match. Example: 'Task' finds all methods returning Task

attributes.description: Optional: filter by attributes (must have ALL specified). Example: ['ObsoleteAttribute', 'EditorBrowsableAttribute']

parameterIncludes.description: Optional: filter methods that MUST have these parameter types (partial match). Example: ['CancellationToken']

parameterExcludes.description: Optional: filter methods that must NOT have these parameter types (partial match). Example: ['CancellationToken']

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results (default: 100)

tools.name: get_diagnostics
tools.description: Get compiler errors, warnings, info messages, AND configured analyzer findings (StyleCop, Roslynator, NetAnalyzers, custom analyzers; editorconfig-resolved severities) for a file or project. Use before committing - this matches what CI will fail on. Response includes analyzersRan and analyzerCount so callers know whether analyzers contributed.

filePath.description: Optional: path to specific file, omit for all files

severity.description: Optional: filter by severity (Error, Warning, Info)

runAnalyzers.description: Run configured DiagnosticAnalyzers in addition to the compiler (default: true). Set false for a fast compiler-only pass when speed matters; otherwise leave true so output matches CI build behavior.

tools.name: get_code_fixes
tools.description: Get the available code fixes for a specific diagnostic, from the same fix providers apply_code_fix uses - each entry's index can be passed straight to apply_code_fix as fixIndex. When no provider can fix the diagnostic, fallbackSuggestions carries manual guidance instead. WORKFLOW: (1) get_diagnostics to find issues, (2) get_code_fixes to see options, (3) apply_code_fix with fixIndex to fix.

line.description: Zero-based line number

tools.name: apply_code_fix
tools.description: Apply automated code fix for a diagnostic. WORKFLOW: (1) Call with no fixIndex to list available fixes, (2) Call with fixIndex and preview=true to preview changes, (3) Call with preview=false to apply. IMPORTANT: Uses ZERO-BASED coordinates.

line.description: Zero-based line number (editor line - 1)

fixIndex.description: Index of fix to apply (omit to list available fixes). Call without this parameter first to see available fixes.

preview.description: Preview mode (default: true). Set to false to apply changes to disk. ALWAYS preview first!

tools.name: get_project_structure
tools.description: Get solution/project structure. IMPORTANT: For large solutions (100+ projects), use summaryOnly=true or projectNamePattern to avoid token limit errors. Maximum output is limited to 25,000 tokens.

includeReferences.description: Include package references (default: true, limited to 100 per project)

includeDocuments.description: Include document lists (default: false, limited to 500 per project)

projectNamePattern.description: Filter projects by name pattern (supports * and ? wildcards, e.g., '*.Application' or 'MyApp.*')

maxProjects.description: Maximum number of projects to return (e.g., 10 for large solutions)

summaryOnly.description: Return only project names and counts (default: false, recommended for large solutions)

tools.name: organize_usings
tools.description: Remove unused using directives (the compiler's CS8019 verdict) and sort the rest: global usings first, then plain (System namespaces leading), then static, then aliases - alphabetical within each group. PREVIEW mode by default returns the organized text; set preview=false to apply to the file.

preview.description: Preview mode (default: true) returns organizedText without changing the file. Set to false to apply.

tools.name: organize_usings_batch
tools.description: Organize using directives for multiple files in a project. Supports file pattern filtering (e.g., '*.cs', 'Services/*.cs'). PREVIEW mode by default - set preview=false to apply changes.

projectName.description: Optional: Project name to process. If omitted, processes all projects in solution.

filePattern.description: Optional: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g., '*.cs', 'Services/*.cs', '*Repository.cs'). Matches against file names, not full paths.

preview.description: Preview mode (default: true). Set to false to apply changes to disk. ALWAYS preview first!

tools.name: format_document_batch
tools.description: Format multiple documents in a project using Roslyn's whitespace formatter. Fixes indentation, spacing, and line breaks per the workspace's formatting rules without rewriting stylistic choices (null-suppression spacing and intentional blank lines are preserved). PREVIEW mode by default - set preview=false to apply changes.

projectName.description: Optional: Project name to format. If omitted, formats all projects in solution.

includeTests.description: Include test projects (default: true). Set to false to skip projects with 'Test' in the name.

filePattern.description: Optional: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g., '*.cs', 'Services/*.cs', '*Repository.cs'). Matches against file names, not full paths.

mode.description: Formatting engine: 'whitespace' (default) fixes indentation/spacing and preserves the author's style — safe for whole projects. 'canonical' fully re-prints the syntax tree: the only mode that expands minified one-liner code, but it REWRITES stylistic whitespace (null-suppression spacing, blank lines between members) — use only on files you intend to fully restyle.

preview.description: Preview mode (default: true). Set to false to apply changes to disk. ALWAYS preview first!

tools.name: get_method_overloads
tools.description: Get all overloads of a method. Returns list of signatures with parameter details. Use when you need to choose between overloads. IMPORTANT: Uses ZERO-BASED coordinates (editor line - 1).

line.description: Zero-based line number

tools.name: get_containing_member
tools.description: Get information about the containing method/property/class at a position. Returns the enclosing symbol's name, kind, and signature. Useful for understanding context. IMPORTANT: Uses ZERO-BASED coordinates (editor line - 1).

line.description: Zero-based line number

tools.name: find_callers
tools.description: Find all methods/properties that call or reference a specific symbol (inverse of find_references). Essential for impact analysis: 'If I change this method, what code will be affected?' IMPORTANT: Uses ZERO-BASED coordinates.

line.description: Zero-based line number (editor line - 1)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of call sites to return (default: 100). Results are truncated with a hint if limit is exceeded.

tools.name: find_unused_code
tools.description:
Find unused types, methods, properties, and fields in a project or entire solution. Returns symbols with zero references (excluding their declaration).

USAGE: find_unused_code() for entire solution, or find_unused_code(projectName="MyProject") for specific project.
OUTPUT: List of unused symbols with location, kind, and accessibility. Default limit: 50 results.

projectName.description: Optional: analyze specific project by name, omit to analyze entire solution

includeInternal.description: Include internal members (default: false - usually want to keep internal APIs)

maxResults.description: Maximum results to return (default: 50, helps manage large outputs)

tools.name: rename_symbol
tools.description: Safely rename a symbol (type, method, property, etc.) across the entire solution. Uses Roslyn's semantic analysis to ensure all references are updated. SUPPORTS PREVIEW MODE - always preview first! ADDRESSING: use EITHER filePath+line+column (zero-based coordinates) OR typeName(+memberName) - exactly one mode. Default shows first 20 files with summary verbosity.

filePath.description: Positional addressing: absolute path to source file containing the symbol

line.description: Positional addressing: zero-based line number (editor line - 1)

column.description: Positional addressing: zero-based column number (editor column - 1)

typeName.description: Name-based addressing: type to target (fully-qualified, simple, or unique partial name). Use INSTEAD of filePath/line/column.

memberName.description: Name-based addressing: member of typeName to rename. Omit to rename the type itself.

overloadIndex.description: Name-based addressing: zero-based overload index when memberName is overloaded (see get_method_overloads)

preview.description: Preview changes without applying (default: true). ALWAYS preview first!

maxFiles.description: Max files to show in preview (default: 20, prevents large outputs)

verbosity.description: Output detail level: 'summary' (default, file paths + counts only ~200 tokens/file), 'compact' (add locations ~500 tokens/file), 'full' (include old/new text ~3000+ tokens/file)

tools.name: extract_interface
tools.description:
Generate an interface from a class or struct. Extracts all public instance members (methods, properties, events).

USAGE: Address the class by typeName="MyService" (or position on its declaration), provide interfaceName="IMyService".
OUTPUT: Generated interface code ready to insert. Useful for dependency injection and testability.
ADDRESSING: use EITHER typeName OR filePath+line+column (zero-based) - exactly one mode.

filePath.description: Positional addressing: absolute path to source file containing the class

line.description: Positional addressing: zero-based line number (editor line - 1)

column.description: Positional addressing: zero-based column number (editor column - 1)

typeName.description: Name-based addressing: type to extract from (fully-qualified, simple, or unique partial name). Use INSTEAD of filePath/line/column.

includeMemberNames.description: Optional: specific member names to include (omit to include all public members)

tools.name: dependency_graph
tools.description:
Visualize project dependencies as a graph. Shows which projects reference which, detects circular dependencies.

OUTPUT: format="json" returns structured data with nodes/edges. format="mermaid" returns diagram syntax.
USE CASE: Understand solution architecture, find circular dependencies, plan refactoring.

format.description: Output format: 'json' (default) returns structured data, 'mermaid' returns Mermaid diagram syntax

tools.name: get_type_members
tools.description:
Get all members (methods, properties, fields, events) of a type BY NAME.

USAGE PATTERNS:
- Basic: get_type_members("MyClass") - list all members
- With inheritance: get_type_members("MyService", includeInherited=true)
- Filter by kind: get_type_members("MyClass", memberKind="Method")
- Verbosity control: verbosity="summary" (names only), "compact" (default, + signatures), "full" (+ docs, attrs)

WORKS WITH: Fully-qualified ("MyNamespace.MyClass"), simple ("MyClass"), or partial names.

typeName.description: Type name (e.g., 'MyClass', 'MyNamespace.MyService')

includeInherited.description: Include members from base classes (default: false)

maxResults.description: Maximum members to return (default: 100)

tools.name: get_method_signature
tools.description:
Get detailed method signature BY NAME including parameters, return type, nullability, and modifiers.

USAGE: get_method_signature("MyClass", "ProcessData") or with overload selection: get_method_signature("MyClass", "ProcessData", overloadIndex=1)

typeName.description: Containing type name

tools.name: get_attributes
tools.description:
Find all symbols with specific attributes.

USAGE:
- Find obsolete: get_attributes("Obsolete")
- Find serializable: get_attributes("Serializable")
- Scope to project: get_attributes("Obsolete", scope="project:MyProject")
- Scope to file: get_attributes("Obsolete", scope="file:MyClass.cs")

maxResults.description: Maximum results (default: 100)

tools.name: get_derived_types
tools.description:
Find all types inheriting from a base type BY NAME.

USAGE:
- Find all subclasses: get_derived_types("BaseService")
- Direct children only: get_derived_types("BaseClass", includeTransitive=false)

maxResults.description: Maximum results (default: 100)

tools.name: get_base_types
tools.description:
Get full inheritance chain BY NAME.

USAGE: get_base_types("MyService") returns: MyService → BaseService → ... → Object

typeName.description: Type name

tools.name: analyze_data_flow
tools.description:
Analyze variable assignments and usage in a code region.

Returns: variablesDeclared, alwaysAssigned, dataFlowsIn/Out, readInside/Outside, writtenInside/Outside, captured.

USAGE: analyze_data_flow("path/to/file.cs", startLine=10, endLine=25)

tools.name: analyze_control_flow
tools.description:
Analyze branching and reachability in a code region.

Returns: entryPoints, exitPoints, returnStatements, endPointIsReachable.

USAGE: analyze_control_flow("path/to/file.cs", startLine=10, endLine=25)

tools.name: get_type_overview
tools.description:
Get comprehensive type overview in ONE CALL: type info + base types (first 3) + member counts.

USAGE: get_type_overview("MyService") - returns everything you need to understand a type quickly.

typeName.description: Type name

tools.name: analyze_method
tools.description:
Get comprehensive method analysis in ONE CALL: signature + callers + outgoing calls + location.

USAGE: analyze_method("MyService", "ProcessData") or analyze_method("MyClass", "Calculate", includeCallers=true, includeOutgoingCalls=true)

typeName.description: Containing type name

includeOutgoingCalls.description: Include methods/properties this method calls (default: false)

overloadIndex.description: 0-based overload to analyze when the method name is overloaded; omit to get an AMBIGUOUS_MATCH listing the overloads

tools.name: get_file_overview
tools.description:
Get comprehensive file overview in ONE CALL: diagnostics summary + type declarations (each with a member outline) + namespace + line count. The agent's substitute for reading a whole file.

USAGE: get_file_overview("path/to/MyClass.cs")
OUTPUT: typeDeclarations[] each with members[] {name, kind, signature, accessibility, startLine, endLine} declared IN THIS FILE (a partial lists only its own part); nested types appear both as a member and as their own entry. members is capped at maxMembersPerType (default 100) with membersTruncated flagged.

maxMembersPerType.description: Cap on members listed per type, 1-1000 (default: 100); membersTruncated flags when exceeded

tools.name: get_missing_members
tools.description:
Get all interface and abstract members that must be implemented for a type.

USAGE: Position on a class that implements interfaces or extends abstract classes.
OUTPUT: List of missing members with exact signatures ready to copy. Use before implementing interfaces.
IMPORTANT: Uses ZERO-BASED coordinates (editor line - 1).

line.description: Zero-based line number on the type declaration

tools.name: get_outgoing_calls
tools.description: Get all methods and properties that a method calls. Helps understand method dependencies and behavior. Returns list of called symbols with locations. IMPORTANT: Uses ZERO-BASED coordinates (editor line - 1).

line.description: Zero-based line number inside the method

maxDepth.description: How deep to trace calls into in-source callees, 1-10 (1 = direct only, default: 1). Each entry reports the hop it was found at in its depth field.

tools.name: validate_code
tools.description:
Check if code would compile without writing to disk. Use to validate generated code before applying.

USAGE: validate_code(code="public void Foo() {}", contextFilePath="path/to/file.cs") to check with existing usings.
OUTPUT: compiles (bool), errors list with line numbers. Essential before inserting AI-generated code.

contextFilePath.description: Optional: file to use for context (usings, namespace)

standalone.description: If true, treat code as complete file (default: false)

tools.name: check_type_compatibility
tools.description:
Check if one type can be assigned to another. Use before generating assignments or casts.

USAGE: check_type_compatibility(sourceType="MyDerivedClass", targetType="MyBaseClass")
OUTPUT: compatible (bool), requiresCast (bool), conversionKind, and explanation of why/why not.

tools.name: get_instantiation_options
tools.description:
Get all ways to create an instance of a type: constructors, factory methods, and builder patterns.

USAGE: get_instantiation_options(typeName="HttpClient")
OUTPUT: List of constructors with signatures, static factory methods, and hints (e.g., "implements IDisposable").

typeName.description: The type name to check (e.g., 'HttpClient')

tools.name: analyze_change_impact
tools.description:
Analyze what would break if you change a symbol. Identifies breaking changes before you make them.

USAGE: analyze_change_impact(filePath, line, column, changeType="rename|changeType|addParameter|removeParameter")
OUTPUT: List of impacted locations, whether change is safe, and specific issues at each location.
IMPORTANT: Uses ZERO-BASED coordinates (editor line - 1).

line.description: Zero-based line number of the symbol

changeType.description: Type of change: rename, changeType, addParameter, removeParameter, changeAccessibility, delete

tools.name: get_method_source
tools.description:
Get the actual source code of a method by type and method name. Eliminates need for file Read.

USAGE: get_method_source(typeName="MyService", methodName="ProcessData")
OUTPUT: Full method source including signature, body, location (file + line numbers), and line count.

typeName.description: The containing type name (e.g., 'MyService', 'MyController')

tools.name: get_method_source_batch
tools.description:
Get source code for multiple methods in a single call (batch optimization).

USAGE: get_method_source_batch(methods: [{typeName: 'ServiceA', methodName: 'Process'}, {typeName: 'ServiceB', methodName: 'Handle'}])
OUTPUT: Results array with source for each method, plus errors array for any that failed.
BENEFIT: One call instead of multiple - reduces round trips when tracing code flows.

typeName.description: Containing type name

tools.name: generate_constructor
tools.description:
Generate a constructor from fields and/or properties of a type.

USAGE: Address the type by typeName="MyService" (or position on its declaration). Use includeProperties=true for auto-properties.
OUTPUT: constructorCode string ready to paste, parameter list, and field assignments.
ADDRESSING: use EITHER typeName OR filePath+line+column (zero-based) - exactly one mode.

filePath.description: Positional addressing: absolute path to source file containing the type

line.description: Positional addressing: zero-based line number on the type declaration

typeName.description: Name-based addressing: type to generate for (fully-qualified, simple, or unique partial name). Use INSTEAD of filePath/line/column.

initializeToDefault.description: Use ?? default for nullable types (default: false)

tools.name: change_signature
tools.description:
Change a method signature and preview impact on all call sites.

ACTIONS: add (new param), remove, rename, reorder parameters.
WORKFLOW: (1) Call with preview=true (default) to see affected call sites, (2) Review changes, (3) Call with preview=false to apply.
OUTPUT: oldSignature, newSignature, list of call sites needing updates.
ADDRESSING: use EITHER typeName+memberName OR filePath+line+column (zero-based) - exactly one mode.

filePath.description: Positional addressing: absolute path to source file containing the method

line.description: Positional addressing: zero-based line number on the method

typeName.description: Name-based addressing: type containing the method (fully-qualified, simple, or unique partial name). Use INSTEAD of filePath/line/column.

memberName.description: Name-based addressing: method to change (required with typeName). Use the type's simple name or '.ctor' for constructors.

overloadIndex.description: Name-based addressing: zero-based overload index when memberName is overloaded (see get_method_overloads)

position.description: Position to insert (for add), -1 means end

preview.description: Preview mode (default: true). Set to false to apply changes.

tools.name: extract_method
tools.description:
Extract selected statements into a new method. Uses data flow analysis to determine parameters and return type.

USAGE: Specify startLine/endLine range containing complete statements inside a method.
OUTPUT: extractedCode (the new method), replacementCode (the call to insert), detected parameters and return type.
WORKFLOW: (1) Preview with preview=true, (2) Apply with preview=false.
IMPORTANT: Uses ZERO-BASED coordinates (editor line - 1).

preview.description: Preview mode (default: true). Set to false to apply.

tools.name: get_code_actions_at_position
tools.description:
Get ALL available code actions (fixes + refactorings) at a position. This is the master tool that exposes 100+ Roslyn refactorings.

USAGE: get_code_actions_at_position(filePath, line, column) or with selection: add endLine, endColumn
OUTPUT: List of actions with title, kind (fix/refactoring), equivalenceKey
WORKFLOW: (1) Call this to see available actions, (2) Use apply_code_action_by_title to apply one
IMPORTANT: Uses ZERO-BASED coordinates (editor line - 1).

line.description: Zero-based line number

tools.name: apply_code_action_by_title
tools.description:
Apply a code action by its title. Supports exact and partial matching.

USAGE: apply_code_action_by_title(filePath, line, column, title)
OUTPUT: Changed files with preview or applied changes
WORKFLOW: (1) Call get_code_actions_at_position first, (2) Apply with preview=true, (3) Apply with preview=false
IMPORTANT: Uses ZERO-BASED coordinates (editor line - 1).

line.description: Zero-based line number

preview.description: Preview mode (default: true). Set to false to apply.

tools.name: implement_missing_members
tools.description:
Generate stub implementations for interface/abstract members.

USAGE: Position cursor on class declaration that implements interface or extends abstract class.
OUTPUT: Generated stub code for all missing members.
IMPORTANT: Uses ZERO-BASED coordinates (editor line - 1).

line.description: Zero-based line number on the class declaration

tools.name: encapsulate_field
tools.description:
Convert a field to a property with getter/setter.

USAGE: Position cursor on a field declaration.
OUTPUT: Generated property wrapping the field.
IMPORTANT: Uses ZERO-BASED coordinates (editor line - 1).

line.description: Zero-based line number on the field

tools.name: inline_variable
tools.description:
Inline a variable, replacing all usages with its value.

USAGE: Position cursor on a variable declaration or usage.
OUTPUT: Variable removed and all usages replaced with the expression.
IMPORTANT: Uses ZERO-BASED coordinates (editor line - 1).

line.description: Zero-based line number

tools.name: extract_variable
tools.description:
Extract an expression to a local variable.

USAGE: Position cursor on or select an expression.
OUTPUT: Expression extracted to a new local variable.
IMPORTANT: Uses ZERO-BASED coordinates (editor line - 1).

line.description: Zero-based line number

tools.name: get_complexity_metrics
tools.description:
Get complexity metrics for a method or entire file.

METRICS: cyclomatic (decision points), nesting (max depth), loc (lines), parameters (count), cognitive (Sonar-style)
USAGE: get_complexity_metrics(filePath) for file, or add line/column for specific method
OUTPUT: Per-method breakdown with all requested metrics
IMPORTANT: Uses ZERO-BASED coordinates (editor line - 1).

line.description: Optional: zero-based line for specific method

metrics.description: Optional: specific metrics [cyclomatic, nesting, loc, parameters, cognitive]

tools.name: add_null_checks
tools.description:
Add ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull guard clauses for nullable parameters.

USAGE: Address the method by typeName+memberName (or position cursor on its declaration).
OUTPUT: Generated guard clauses inserted at method start.
ADDRESSING: use EITHER typeName+memberName OR filePath+line+column (zero-based) - exactly one mode.

filePath.description: Positional addressing: absolute path to source file

line.description: Positional addressing: zero-based line number on the method

typeName.description: Name-based addressing: type containing the method (fully-qualified, simple, or unique partial name). Use INSTEAD of filePath/line/column.

memberName.description: Name-based addressing: method to guard (required with typeName)

overloadIndex.description: Name-based addressing: zero-based overload index when memberName is overloaded (see get_method_overloads)

tools.name: generate_equality_members
tools.description:
Generate Equals, GetHashCode, and == / != operators for a type.

USAGE: Address the type by typeName="MyValue" (or position cursor on its declaration).
OUTPUT: Generated equality members comparing all instance fields and properties.
ADDRESSING: use EITHER typeName OR filePath+line+column (zero-based) - exactly one mode.

filePath.description: Positional addressing: absolute path to source file

line.description: Positional addressing: zero-based line number on the type

typeName.description: Name-based addressing: type to generate for (fully-qualified, simple, or unique partial name). Use INSTEAD of filePath/line/column.

tools.name: get_type_members_batch
tools.description:
Get members for multiple types in a single call (batch optimization).

USAGE: get_type_members_batch(typeNames: ['ServiceA', 'ServiceB', 'ControllerC'])
OUTPUT: Results for each type with members, or error if type not found
BENEFIT: One call instead of multiple - reduces context usage for AI agents

typeNames.description: Array of type names to look up

tools.name: find_attribute_usages
tools.description:
Find all types and members decorated with a specific attribute.

USAGE: find_attribute_usages(attributeName: "Authorize")
USAGE: find_attribute_usages(attributeName: "HttpGet", projectName: "MyApi")

OUTPUT: List of symbols with the attribute, their kind, arguments, and source location.
Use for: finding all API endpoints, authorization points, serialization config, test fixtures.

projectName.description: Filter to specific project

maxResults.description: Maximum results (default: 100)

tools.name: get_di_registrations
tools.description:
Scan for dependency injection service registrations (AddScoped, AddTransient, AddSingleton, etc.).

USAGE: get_di_registrations()
USAGE: get_di_registrations(projectName: "MyApi")

OUTPUT: List of DI registrations with lifetime, service type, implementation type, and location.
Use for: understanding service wiring, finding missing registrations, auditing lifetimes.

projectName.description: Filter to specific project

tools.name: find_reflection_usage
tools.description:
Detect dynamic/reflection-based type and method usage that is invisible to static reference searches.

USAGE: find_reflection_usage()
USAGE: find_reflection_usage(projectName: "MyApp", maxResults: 50)

OUTPUT: List of reflection API calls with the API used, context, and location.
Use for: finding hidden dependencies before refactoring, security audits, understanding dynamic behavior.

projectName.description: Filter to specific project

maxResults.description: Maximum results (default: 100)

tools.name: find_circular_dependencies
tools.description:
Detect cycles in project or namespace dependency graphs.

USAGE: find_circular_dependencies() — project-level cycles
USAGE: find_circular_dependencies(level: "namespace") — namespace-level cycles

OUTPUT: Dependency graph with any detected cycles listed.
Use for: architecture analysis, identifying tightly coupled components.

tools.name: get_nuget_dependencies
tools.description:
List NuGet package references per project with versions.

USAGE: get_nuget_dependencies()
USAGE: get_nuget_dependencies(projectName: "MyApp")

OUTPUT: List of projects with their NuGet packages, versions, and asset settings.
Use for: dependency audits, version checks, understanding external dependencies.

projectName.description: Filter to specific project

tools.name: get_source_generators
tools.description:
List active source generators and their generated output per project.

USAGE: get_source_generators()
USAGE: get_source_generators(projectName: "MyApp")

OUTPUT: List of generators with their assembly info and generated files.
Use for: understanding generated code, debugging generator issues.

projectName.description: Filter to specific project

tools.name: get_generated_code
tools.description:
View the source code produced by a source generator.

USAGE: get_generated_code(projectName: "MyApp", generatedFileName: "MyType.g.cs")

OUTPUT: Full source code of the generated file.
Use get_source_generators first to discover available generated files.

projectName.description: Project containing the generated file

tools.name: get_project_health
tools.description: Composite audit dashboard for one project: aggregates diagnostics (with analyzers), unused code, god-object candidates, untested public surface, and async-hygiene issues. Returns counts + top-N hotspots per dimension. One call replaces 5+ separate tool calls for a project audit overview.

projectName.description: Project to audit. Required.

includeAnalyzers.description: Run configured DiagnosticAnalyzers in addition to compiler diagnostics (default: true).

tools.name: find_god_objects
tools.description: Detect over-coupled types ('god objects'). For each type computes efferent coupling (distinct types it depends on), afferent coupling (distinct types that depend on it), and member count; reports types meeting both threshold filters, scored as efferent*0.4 + members*0.4 + afferent*0.2. AUDIT-TIME tool — O(types*references); don't call in tight agent loops.

projectName.description: Limit scan to one project (default: scan all projects)

minEfferentCoupling.description: Minimum outbound type dependencies to qualify (default: 20)

maxResults.description: Cap on candidates returned (default: 20). totalCount reflects unbounded match count.

tools.name: find_untested_code
tools.description: Find public/internal surface in a project that no test method (xUnit [Fact]/[Theory], NUnit [Test]/[TestCase], MSTest [TestMethod]) transitively reaches. Sorted by cyclomatic complexity so the riskiest untested code is reported first. Audit-time tool; runs solution-wide BFS.

projectName.description: Project to audit (default: first project in solution)

includeInternal.description: Include internal members (default: false; only public)

maxResults.description: Cap on reported items (default: 50). totalCount reflects the true unbounded count.

tools.name: get_call_graph
tools.description: Multi-hop transitive call graph (callers, callees, or both) from a method. Replaces N round-trips of find_callers/get_outgoing_calls when tracing impact or understanding a subsystem. Returns nodes + edges (not a nested tree, to handle diamond shapes), with cycle detection and a mandatory maxDepth bound. IMPORTANT: Uses ZERO-BASED coordinates.

line.description: Zero-based line of the method declaration or invocation

maxDepth.description: Max BFS depth, 1-10 (default: 3). Required bound; depths above 10 explode on connected graphs.

maxNodes.description: Max total nodes (default: 100). Sets truncatedByNodes when hit.

tools.name: get_external_type_info
tools.description: Inspect types from external assemblies (NuGet packages, BCL, closed-source) the solution references. Returns members, signatures, and structured XML docs (summary/returns/remarks/params/typeParams/exceptions) for types whose source isn't in the solution. Eliminates the need for agents to guess at dependency APIs.

typeName.description: Fully-qualified type name. Use backtick-arity for generics, e.g. 'System.Collections.Generic.List`1'.

assemblyName.description: Optional: restrict resolution to a specific assembly when the type name is ambiguous.

includeInherited.description: Include members from base types (default: true). Stops before System.Object.

includeXmlDocs.description: Include XML doc summaries when available (default: true).

maxMembers.description: Cap on member entries (default: 200). totalCount reflects the unbounded member count.

tools.name: move_type_to_file
tools.description:
Compute the file split that moves a type into its own correctly-named file ({TypeName}.cs in the same folder). The remedy tool for files that accumulate multiple types.

USAGE: move_type_to_file(typeName: "MySecondClass") - the type's usings and namespace shape (file-scoped or block) are preserved in both contents.
OUTPUT: newFilePath plus the full newFileContent and updatedOriginContent. GENERATION-ONLY: never writes - YOU write both files (Write/Edit), then call sync_documents. A type already alone in its file is a no-op success.
Nested types and multi-file partial types are not supported.

typeName.description: Type to move (fully-qualified, simple, or unique partial name)

tools.name: split_type
tools.description:
Compute the partial-class split that moves the named members of a class or struct into a new file. The remedy tool for find_god_objects.

USAGE: split_type(typeName: "MyService", memberNames: ["HelperA", "HelperB"]). All overloads of a listed name move together; the type's simple name addresses constructors.
OUTPUT: newFilePath, movedMembers, partialModifierAdded, plus the full newFileContent and updatedOriginContent. Both halves carry the `partial` modifier. GENERATION-ONLY: never writes - YOU write both files (Write/Edit), then call sync_documents.
Records, nested types, and multi-file partial types are not supported.

typeName.description: Class or struct to split (fully-qualified, simple, or unique partial name)

memberNames.description: Members to move into the new partial. A field declared together with other variables moves only when all of them are listed.

newFileName.description: Bare file name for the new partial (default: '{TypeName}.Partial.cs'; '.cs' appended when missing)

tools.name: diff_api_surface
tools.description:
Public-API breaking-change report against a git ref - the release-prep tool. Rebuilds the baseline API surface from git history (read-only git ls-tree/show) and diffs it against the current code.

USAGE: diff_api_surface(baselineRef: "v1.5.3") or any ref ("HEAD~5", a branch, a commit). Optional projectName restricts to one project.
OUTPUT: breaking[] (removed symbols and changed signatures, including accessibility reductions) and added[] - locations on the current side. Members of a wholly removed or added type collapse into the single type entry.
REQUIRES: the solution must live in a git repository and the ref must exist locally.
NOTE: compares declaration signatures; base-list and attribute changes are not reported.

baselineRef.description: Git ref to diff against: tag, branch, or commit (e.g. 'v1.5.3', 'HEAD~5')

projectName.description: Optional: restrict the comparison to one project (default: every project in the solution)

tools.name: get_exception_flow
tools.description:
Which exception types can escape a method (transitively through its in-source callees), and where each is caught along the way. C# has no checked exceptions - nothing else answers this.

USAGE: get_exception_flow(typeName: "OrderService", memberName: "Submit") or positional filePath+line+column.
OUTPUT: escaping[] (exceptionType + a sample throw site) and caught[] (exceptionType, the catch location in the analyzed method, and the originating throw site). Bare `throw;` counts as the enclosing catch's type.
LIMITS: metadata-only callees (BCL/NuGet) contribute nothing; a catch with a `when` filter is treated as non-catching (conservative); async/Task wrapping is not modeled.
ADDRESSING: use EITHER typeName+memberName OR filePath+line+column (zero-based) - exactly one mode.

filePath.description: Positional addressing: absolute path to source file

line.description: Positional addressing: zero-based line number on the method

typeName.description: Name-based addressing: type containing the method (fully-qualified, simple, or unique partial name). Use INSTEAD of filePath/line/column.

memberName.description: Name-based addressing: method to analyze (required with typeName)

overloadIndex.description: Name-based addressing: zero-based overload index when memberName is overloaded (see get_method_overloads)

maxDepth.description: How many callee levels to follow, 1-10 (default: 3). Depth 1 analyzes only the method's own throws.

tools.name: find_similar_code
tools.description:
Find methods structurally similar to a query method or snippet - the anti-duplication check before implementing a helper that may already exist. Fingerprints are 4-gram shingles over normalized token kinds (identifiers and literals are wildcards), scored by Jaccard similarity, so renamed variables and different constants still match.

USAGE: find_similar_code(typeName: "OrderService", methodName: "Validate") or find_similar_code(snippet: "<code>") - exactly one query mode.
OUTPUT: matching methods with score (0-1), location, and statement count, best first. Candidates are source methods with at least 3 statements.
NOTE: audit-time tool - every call sweeps the solution once; there is no persistent index.

typeName.description: Query by method: type containing it (fully-qualified, simple, or unique partial name)

methodName.description: Query by method: method name within typeName

overloadIndex.description: Query by method: zero-based overload index when methodName is overloaded

snippet.description: Query by raw code instead of an existing method. Use INSTEAD of typeName/methodName.

maxResults.description: Maximum matches to return, best first (default: 10)

tools.name: resolve_stack_trace
tools.description:
Paste a .NET stack trace - frames come back mapped to file/line/symbol with source snippets, compiler name mangling undone: async state machines (Type+<Method>d__N.MoveNext), lambdas (<Method>b__N_M incl. <>c containers), and local functions (<Method>g__Local|N_M).

USAGE: resolve_stack_trace(stackTrace: "<ex.ToString() or log paste>").
OUTPUT: ordered frames {raw, symbol, frameKind (method/async/lambda/localFunction/text), resolved, location, snippet}. Frames with file:line pointing into the solution resolve to that exact statement; frames without resolve to the declaration by name. BCL/third-party frames pass through with resolved: false. Lines are ZERO-based like every other tool (trace's 1-based numbers are converted).

stackTrace.description: The stack trace text (ex.ToString(), a log excerpt, or a pasted fragment)

contextLines.description: Source lines to include either side of each resolved location, 0-20 (default: 2)

tools.name: remove_unused_code
tools.description:
Compute the bulk cleanup for find_unused_code results: every reported declaration removed (all partial declarations; a multi-variable field only when every declarator is dead) plus the using directives the removals made unnecessary.

USAGE: remove_unused_code(symbolNames: ["DeadHelper", "GhostClass"]) for a targeted fast cleanup, or the find_unused_code filters (projectName, includePrivate, includeInternal, symbolKindFilter) for a sweep.
OUTPUT: removed[] and skipped[] per symbol, and files[] with each touched file's FULL updatedContent. GENERATION-ONLY: never writes - YOU write each updatedContent (Write/Edit), then sync_documents and get_diagnostics. Re-run to confirm nothing remains.
NOTE: inherits find_unused_code's heuristics - verify with find_references before deleting anything public.

projectName.description: Restrict the sweep to one project (default: all projects)

symbolNames.description: Allow-list: only these simple names are checked and removed. Much faster than a sweep.

tools.name: generate_test_stub
tools.description:
Generate a compilable test skeleton for a target method - pairs with find_untested_code. The test framework is detected from the solution's test projects (xUnit/NUnit/MSTest attribute types resolving in a compilation; none found defaults to xUnit with frameworkDetected: false). The SUT is constructed via the public constructor with the fewest parameters; interface-typed arguments become TODO-marked default! placeholders; a Task-returning target produces an async Task test.

USAGE: generate_test_stub(typeName: "OrderService", methodName: "Submit").
OUTPUT: testCode, testClassName, suggestedFilePath (the existing {Type}Tests.cs when present, else the test project root), framework. GENERATION-ONLY: never writes - YOU write the stub and fill in the TODOs.

typeName.description: Type declaring the method (fully-qualified, simple, or unique partial name)

methodName.description: Method to generate a test for

overloadIndex.description: Zero-based overload index when methodName is overloaded (see get_method_overloads)

tools.name: check_architecture
tools.description:
Enforce dependency rules over the real type-dependency graph: every type-to-type edge (signature types plus body usages - object creation, casts, typeof, call receivers, local declarations) is checked against your deny rules.

USAGE: check_architecture(rules: [{ "from": "MyApp.Domain*", "deny": "MyApp.Infrastructure*" }]). Globs (* and ?) match namespaces by default; level="project" matches project names instead.
OUTPUT: violations[] with fromType, toType, the matched rule, and a representative source location (null when the dependency is signature-only), plus rulesEvaluated and edgesChecked.

from.description: Glob matching the SOURCE namespace (or project with level='project')

deny.description: Glob matching the FORBIDDEN target namespace (or project)

level.description: 'namespace' (default) or 'project' - what the globs match against

tools.name: find_unused_dependencies
tools.description:
Which declared PackageReference / ProjectReference entries the compiler never actually needs - Roslyn's own GetUsedAssemblyReferences verdict per project.

USAGE: find_unused_dependencies() or find_unused_dependencies(projectName: "MyApp").
OUTPUT: per project - unusedPackages, unusedProjectReferences, and skipped entries with reasons (PrivateAssets=all build assets; packages contributing no compile-time assemblies like analyzers/source generators cannot be judged this way).
CAVEAT: compile-time verdict only - a package loaded purely via reflection (plugins, MEF) appears unused. Verify with find_reflection_usage before removing.

projectName.description: Restrict the audit to one project (default: every project)

tools.name: find_dead_branches
tools.description:
Unreachable basic blocks per method body, from the real control-flow graph (not syntax heuristics): code after return/throw, constant-false branches, code after non-breaking infinite loops.

USAGE: find_dead_branches(filePath: "src/MyService.cs") or find_dead_branches(projectName: "MyApp") - exactly one scope.
OUTPUT: deadBranches[] with the owning method, the first unreachable statement's location, and a snippet; methodsAnalyzed for scan scope. Top-level bodies only - a local function's or lambda's interior flow is not walked.

filePath.description: Scan one file. Use INSTEAD of projectName.

projectName.description: Scan every document of one project. Use INSTEAD of filePath.

maxResults.description: Cap on reported dead branches, 1-500 (default: 50); totalCount reflects all found

tools.name: add_missing_imports
tools.description:
Compute the using directives that fix a file's CS0246/CS0103 diagnostics - compiler-accurate import suggestion over every namespace the compilation can see (source and referenced metadata).

USAGE: add_missing_imports(filePath: "src/MyService.cs").
OUTPUT: added[] (each name with its namespace and the using line) plus updatedContent with the usings inserted at their sorted position WITHOUT reordering existing ones; ambiguous[] names report their candidate namespaces and change nothing; unresolvable[] names have no candidate. GENERATION-ONLY: never writes - YOU write updatedContent, then sync_documents and get_diagnostics.

filePath.description: File whose unresolved names should get usings computed

tools.name: find_naming_violations
tools.description:
Naming-convention audit honoring the solution's own .editorconfig dotnet_naming_* rules; when none are configured it falls back to conventional defaults (PascalCase types/methods/properties, camelCase parameters/locals, _camelCase private instance fields - const/static fields exempt).

USAGE: find_naming_violations() or find_naming_violations(projectName: "MyApp").
OUTPUT: violations[] {symbol, kind, rule, expected, location}; rulesSource says 'editorconfig' or 'defaults'; unsupportedRules lists configured rules outside the v1 scope rather than dropping them silently.
V1 SCOPE: kind + accessibility filters, pascal_case/camel_case (incl. word_separator), required prefix/suffix. required_modifiers and other capitalizations are reported unsupported; editorconfig rule precedence is approximated and severity is ignored.

projectName.description: Restrict the audit to one project (default: every project)

maxResults.description: Cap on reported violations, 1-1000 (default: 100); violationCount reflects all found

tools.name: get_extension_methods
tools.description:
Which extension members apply to a type - both classic `this`-parameter extension methods and C# 14 `extension(T receiver)` block members - grouped by their containing static class.

USAGE: get_extension_methods(typeName: "OrderService").
OUTPUT: groups[] {containingClass, members[] {name, style: 'classic'|'extensionBlock', kind, signature, location}}. Source-declared extensions only; an extension block applies when the target type is (or implicitly reference-converts to) its receiver type.

typeName.description: Target type (fully-qualified, simple, or unique partial name)

maxResults.description: Cap on extension members reported, 1-500 (default: 50); totalCount reflects all found

tools.name: find_interceptors
tools.description:
Surface [InterceptsLocation] call rerouting - the hidden control flow behind ASP.NET minimal APIs, EF compiled models, and hand-written interceptors. Scans every tree of the generator-augmented compilation (generated code included, where most interceptors live), matching the attribute by simple name.

USAGE: find_interceptors() or find_interceptors(projectName: "MyApi").
OUTPUT: interceptors[] {interceptorMethod, interceptorLocation, target, inGeneratedCode}. Legacy (filePath, line, character) targets convert to ZERO-based line/column and include the intercepted line's text when the file is a solution document; (version, data) targets surface the raw data string undecoded.

projectName.description: Restrict the scan to one project (default: every project)

maxResults.description: Cap on reported interceptors, 1-1000 (default: 100); totalCount reflects all found

tools.name: get_documentation
tools.description:
Full XML documentation for a symbol with <inheritdoc> resolved recursively - other tools return the raw tag. A member-level <inheritdoc> (bare or cref) is expanded element-by-element: inherited content fills the sections, params, and exceptions the local doc omits.

USAGE: get_documentation(typeName: "OrderService") for a type, or with memberName (+ overloadIndex) for a member.
OUTPUT: documentation {summary, returns, remarks, params[], typeParams[], exceptions[]}, inheritedFrom (the symbol docs were inherited from, or null), and unresolved ('cycle' | 'no-inherited-member' | 'unresolved-cref' when an inheritdoc could not be fully resolved). A bare inheritdoc follows the overridden member, the explicit interface member, or the implicitly implemented one.

typeName.description: Type to document (fully-qualified, simple, or unique partial name)

memberName.description: Member to document; omit to document the type itself

overloadIndex.description: Zero-based overload index when memberName is overloaded (see get_method_overloads)

tools.name: fix_all
tools.description:
Compute the fix for EVERY instance of a diagnostic id across a file, project, or the whole solution - "remove all unused usings", "drop every unused variable". Uses the provider's own batch FixAll where available, falling back to an iterative fix-recompute-repeat loop.

USAGE: fix_all(diagnosticId: "CS0219", scope: "solution"). scope 'file' requires filePath; 'project' requires projectName. fixIndex picks among the available fixes (default 0; see get_code_fixes).
OUTPUT: files[] with each touched file's full updatedContent, diagnosticsMatched, fixTitle, and fallbackMode. GENERATION-ONLY: never writes - YOU write each updatedContent, then sync_documents and get_diagnostics.
NOTE: operates on compiler diagnostics (e.g. CS0219, CS8019); analyzer-only ids are out of scope.

diagnosticId.description: The diagnostic id to fix everywhere, e.g. 'CS0219'

filePath.description: Required when scope='file': the file to fix

projectName.description: Required when scope='project': the project to fix

fixIndex.description: Which available fix to apply (default 0; see get_code_fixes)

tools.name: find_tests
tools.description:
Which tests cover a symbol - the inverse of find_untested_code. Each test method's transitive reach is computed by BFS over in-source callees; a test covers the target when its reach includes it.

USAGE: find_tests(typeName: "OrderService", memberName: "Submit"). Omit memberName to ask which tests touch ANY member of the type. overloadIndex disambiguates overloads.
OUTPUT: coveringTests[] {testMethod, containingType, testProject, location} and totalTests.
NOTE: audit-time tool - one solution sweep per call, no caching.

typeName.description: Type containing the target (fully-qualified, simple, or unique partial name)

memberName.description: Member to find covering tests for; omit to target the type itself

overloadIndex.description: Zero-based overload index when memberName is overloaded (see get_method_overloads)

tools.name: get_super_method
tools.description:
Navigate from an override or implementation to what it overrides / implements. Reports the full base-member chain plus every interface member the symbol satisfies (explicit and implicit). Works for methods, properties, and events.

USAGE: get_super_method(typeName: "MyImpl", memberName: "Handle") or positional filePath+line+column.
OUTPUT: overrides[] (the OverriddenX chain, root-ward) and implements[] (interface members), each {signature, containingType, location|inMetadata}.
ADDRESSING: use EITHER typeName+memberName OR filePath+line+column (zero-based) - exactly one mode.

filePath.description: Positional addressing: absolute path to source file

line.description: Positional addressing: zero-based line number on the member

typeName.description: Name-based addressing: type containing the member. Use INSTEAD of filePath/line/column.

memberName.description: Name-based addressing: member to navigate from (required with typeName)

overloadIndex.description: Name-based addressing: zero-based overload index when memberName is overloaded

tools.name: find_type_instantiations
tools.description:
Where a type is constructed - every `new T(...)` and target-typed `new(...)` whose type is T. Complements find_references when you specifically want construction sites.

USAGE: find_type_instantiations(typeName: "OrderService").
OUTPUT: matches[] {location, lineText, kind} over source code (no generated trees, no metadata).

typeName.description: Type to find constructions of (fully-qualified, simple, or unique partial name)

maxResults.description: Cap on results, 1-1000 (default: 100); totalCount reflects all found

tools.name: find_pattern_usages
tools.description:
Where a type appears in a type test or pattern - `x is T`, `x as T`, declaration/type/recursive patterns against T.

USAGE: find_pattern_usages(typeName: "HttpException").
OUTPUT: matches[] {location, lineText, kind} where kind is isExpression/asExpression/declarationPattern/typePattern/recursivePattern.

typeName.description: Type to find pattern matches against (fully-qualified, simple, or unique partial name)

maxResults.description: Cap on results, 1-1000 (default: 100); totalCount reflects all found

tools.name: find_throw_sites
tools.description:
Where an exception type is thrown - `throw new T(...)` and throw expressions. With includeDerived (default true), also throws of types deriving from T.

USAGE: find_throw_sites(typeName: "InvalidOperationException").
OUTPUT: matches[] {location, lineText, kind} over source code.

typeName.description: Exception type to find throw sites of (fully-qualified, simple, or unique partial name)

includeDerived.description: Also match throws of derived types (default: true)

maxResults.description: Cap on results, 1-1000 (default: 100); totalCount reflects all found

tools.name: find_catch_blocks
tools.description:
Where an exception type is caught - `catch (T ...)` clauses. With includeDerived (default true), also catch clauses whose declared type is a base of T (which would catch a T).

USAGE: find_catch_blocks(typeName: "IOException").
OUTPUT: matches[] {location, lineText, kind} over source code.

typeName.description: Exception type to find catch blocks for (fully-qualified, simple, or unique partial name)

includeDerived.description: Also match catches whose declared type is a base of the target (default: true)

maxResults.description: Cap on results, 1-1000 (default: 100); totalCount reflects all found

tools.name: find_async_issues
tools.description:
Async-hygiene audit of the three highest-signal problems: async void that isn't an event handler (its exceptions crash the process), blocking on async work (.Result / .Wait() / .GetAwaiter().GetResult() on a Task), and a CancellationToken parameter that isn't forwarded to an awaited call that could take one.

USAGE: find_async_issues() or find_async_issues(projectName: "MyApp").
OUTPUT: issues[] {category: asyncVoid|blockingCall|tokenNotForwarded, symbol, detail, location} and countByCategory. The total also appears in get_project_health.

projectName.description: Restrict the audit to one project (default: every project)

maxResults.description: Cap on reported issues, 1-1000 (default: 100); totalCount reflects all found
